# Ismail Kattakath

> Ismail Kattakath is a principal software engineer in Toronto, Canada. He builds the platform AI products run on: multi-tenant AI SaaS on AWS, tenant isolation, AI usage billing, inference cost and Document AI, in production since 2010. ismail.kattakath.com is his professional page: what he owns, selected work, career and contact.

- Currently principal software engineer at Infin8 Information Technologies (Takeoff, an AEC estimation SaaS on AWS).
- Open to principal and staff roles, and to consulting: advisory, fractional principal, build-and-hand-over. Remote from Toronto.
- Contact: ismail@kattakath.com · https://linkedin.com/in/ismailkattakath · https://github.com/ismailkattakath
